# MILES seed `data/lcs/realfirst/cmp/v12_147/miles1_d3`

Created 2026-11-01T21:47:12-0500, git 7177c1db96, seed 20261123, LCM `udpm://239.255.76.253:7853?ttl=0`, wall 10.8 min, robot 582.0 s sim, 335 files / 7651 frames.

Cycles: 4 per waypoint, dev 0.8 s (min-jerk) + return 0.8 s (straight line, min-jerk) + hold 0.2 s; box free +-30 mm / +-8 deg, contact +-10 mm / +-4 deg; single-axis draws 0 (Franka x/y, UR x/y/z at the edge); clearance scaling >= min(2 mm, d at the waypoint), Franka tip >= 4 mm. Reach 4 mm / 2 deg vs the waypoint target; belt check vs the waypoint arrival cloud; on disturbed: skip-waypoint.

## Disturbance threshold

tau[phase] = p95 of the symmetric Chamfer (mean NN) of pcd_belt_seg between every same-grasp pair of clean demos at matched demo frames (frames move0..end; free = before the first demo's latch, contact = from it); gt_tau likewise on the Chamfer of the 150 GT belt material points (shape only: sliding along the belt is not a disturbance; report-only).

| measure | phase | n | p50 | p95 | max | tau |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chamfer (check) | free | 167 | 2.48 | 3.32 | 4.00 | 3.32 |
| Chamfer (check) | contact | 2173 | 1.61 | 1.82 | 2.50 | 1.82 |
| GT belt Chamfer (report) | free | 167 | 3.00 | 4.00 | 5.28 | 4.00 |
| GT belt Chamfer (report) | contact | 2173 | 1.49 | 1.72 | 2.41 | 1.72 |

`--tau-mm 1.82` overrides the check tau (both phases).
